_deal: Assault, beside 45a and 46a: the classic Sabotage families (MB19, MB20) deal from Assault. His 2026-10-28 "promote 52a to assualt"; moved by gen_delve move, never a rebuild.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-17 09:51: "do the next 5 as well, Json is cheap". First Delve of the old MB20 Sabotage (books) family. Old MB20a: 'A cache of banned texts has turned up. The order is destruction, not confiscation, and nobody has offered a reason.'
_note: THE BANNED TEXTS. The old line's best part is the missing reason, so the Delve keeps it missing. No choice offered:
the job is the job, and the journal is where the player gets to have a feeling about it.
SABOTAGE IS DESTROY (his 2026-10-28 13:07): the classic MB20 cache was shot, not opened. One beat, the cache destroyed
and burning; words rewritten 2026-10-28. The beat is destroy (Eliza's, FrankyCLI 7195765) with the incendiary kept;
vanish dropped, since a destroy stage disables the object itself. Unplayed as destroy.
Issuer: an administrator's office, flat and unexplained (style guide 33 s4). Single ending, so the last beat's say
is the closing radio (his 2026-10-17). Pay: easy, placeholder; the tier is his.

place._theme: A non-hostile site; the only guns are the crew on the cache (who).
place._who: His 2026-10-28 play: "dull... Originally these were defended by there faction". A spacer crew sits on the cache (the old MB20e: boxed and waiting on a hauler), MB42a's built field and list.

prose.name: Sabotage: Banned Texts on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A cache of banned texts has turned up at the <Place>, with an armed crew sitting on it. The posting wants them destroyed, not collected, and doesn't say why.
prose.card: Administrative Contract. A cache of prohibited texts has been located at the <Place> on <Planet>. Armed resistance is expected. Destroy the material on site. Do not remove or copy it. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Destroy the cache of texts at the <Place>
beats.name: Cache of Banned Texts
beats.journal: The cache at the <Place> went up with every book in it. Somebody thought those books were worth a gunfight. I still don't know what was in them, and nobody asked me to know.
say: Destruction confirmed. Your report is filed. There is nothing further on this contract.

broadcast: Contract confirmed. The material is under guard and is to be destroyed on site. Do not read it, remove it or copy it.
_speech: The office on the radio, flat as a form. 'Do not read it' is said once and the journal reads it anyway. Recast 2026-10-22 off Matilda (his: "very robotic") to ElevenLabs' 'Alice, Clear, Engaging Educator', british: clear and official without the robot. Alice then ruled out of the whole cast by his ear 2026-10-27 ("sounds like a phone system instead of a person"); recast to Annie K, heard in game on 32a. His ear decides.
